method: Built-in image generation, edit with concept and report chart references
prompt:
Edit reference image 1 into a new, more compact RaceSide race recap card, portrait 4:5. Reference image 1 is the card to redesign. Reference image 2 is a screenshot of the actual report positions chart, supplied ONLY as a reference for the line colors, relative shape, axes and driver selection; do not copy its modal, browser or navigation.

User's exact changes:
- Compress P1, P2 and P3 into ONE compact horizontal row. This entire podium row must occupy roughly 12–15% of the canvas height. Three equal-width columns separated by fine vertical rules, tiny 64–80px-equivalent helmet avatars, modest P1/P2/P3 labels, readable names, team, time/gap and points. The winner may have a small red P1 label but NO enormous P1 typography and NO giant portrait or separate winner hero.
- Remove the heading "Вокруг этапа" and its entire news paragraph completely.
- Add a large readable line chart showing how positions changed by lap. This is the central analytical feature, roughly 25–28% of the card height. Title: "Позиции по кругам". Use the three podium drivers only, matching the report chart in reference image 2: blue for "Ферстаппен", mint/turquoise for "Антонелли", red for "Хэмилтон". Thin solid crisp step-shaped traces, no smooth decorative waves, no dotted traces, no shaded areas. Hamilton's trace shows a deep early drop and recovery to P3, Verstappen ends P1, Antonelli ends P2. Keep positions bounded by P1–P22; P1 is at the TOP. Use small clear axis labels P1/P5/P10/P15/P20 and race lap ticks 1/10/20/30/40/55, x-axis label "Круг". Keep the chart calm and legible; no tooltip, chart toolbar, plus/minus controls, or "Данные графика". A compact legend with the three names and team colors appears below the chart. Draw a reference-informed concept, not additional race events.

Suggested vertical layout:
1. Compact brand/season header, preserving the actual red RS and white RaceSide logo.
2. Full readable heading "Гран-при Малайзии", subtitle "Сепанг / 4 октября / 55 кругов". Keep "Итоги за минуту" small or integrate it with the header if needed.
3. One compact three-column podium row with portraits from image 1:
"P1" / "Макс Ферстаппен" / "Red Bull" / "1:47:14.808" / "25 очков".
"P2" / "Кими Антонелли" / "Mercedes" / "+2.307" / "18 очков".
"P3" / "Льюис Хэмилтон" / "Ferrari" / "+4.919" / "15 очков".
4. The large positions chart described above.
5. One concise three-column facts strip, using EXACT values:
"Лучший круг" / "1:38.220" / "Ферстаппен".
"Больше всего позиций" / "+12" / "Линдблад".
"На финише" / "19 из 22" / "3 схода".
6. "Очковая десятка" table, two columns of five rows, preserving ALL ten rows and numbers from image 1. Readable headers "Пилот", "Отрыв", "Очки". Do not drop or duplicate any drivers.
Left: 1 Ферстаппен — 25; 2 Антонелли +2.307 18; 3 Хэмилтон +4.919 15; 4 Леклер +7.258 12; 5 Хаджар +8.571 10.
Right: 6 Пиастри +9.454 8; 7 Лоусон +12.753 6; 8 Алонсо +13.372 4; 9 Норрис +13.993 2; 10 Линдблад +15.928 1.
7. "Чемпионат после этапа": "1 Антонелли / 320 очков", "2 Расселл / 236 очков", "3 Хэмилтон / 214 очков", on one compact row.
8. Compact red footer: "Полный отчёт на RaceSide" and "raceside.online".

Invariants: keep the same identities, logo, names, all numeric values, black #090909 background, white text, restrained RaceSide red, team colors, Geist-like typography, thin rules, flat editorial style and full portrait 4:5 format. All Russian text must be correctly spelled and legible. No card-inside-card styling, no gradients, no gold podium ornaments, no giant portraits, no glow, no browser chrome, no QR code, no new statistics, no news text. Data and the chart should now occupy most of the composition. Fit every section comfortably, no cropping, overlap or compressed illegible tiny text. Output ONE complete finished share card, not a design board.
